# StreamerOS Money Calculators

> Free money calculators: take-home pay, pay raises, salary and hourly pay, overtime, EMI, SIP, GST, India income tax, and live currency conversion for any currency. Instant, with the formula shown.

Built and maintained by Yaseen Khatib, Full Stack AI Developer, Hyderabad, India (https://yk.streamerosai.com/).

## Calculators

- [Paycheck Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/paycheck-calculator/): Paycheck calculator for 2026: see your take-home pay after federal tax, Social Security, Medicare and state tax, for any pay frequency and filing status.
- [Hourly Paycheck Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/hourly-paycheck-calculator/): Hourly paycheck calculator for 2026: enter your hourly rate and weekly hours to see take-home pay after federal tax, Social Security, Medicare and state tax.
- [Pay Raise Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/pay-raise-calculator/): Calculate your new pay after a raise by percent or dollar amount, or find the percentage raise between two pay rates. Free and instant.
- [Salary Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/salary-calculator/): Convert any pay figure between hourly, daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly and annual salary. Set your own hours and weeks. Free and instant.
- [Hourly to Salary Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/hourly-to-salary-calculator/): Hourly salary calculator: convert wages to annual, monthly, bi-weekly and weekly pay. Uses a 2,080-hour year by default and lets you set your own hours.
- [Salary to Hourly Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/salary-to-hourly-calculator/): Salary to hourly calculator: convert an annual or monthly salary to an hourly wage. Uses a 2,080-hour year by default; set your own hours and weeks.
- [Overtime Pay Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/overtime-pay-calculator/): Overtime pay calculator: work out a week of pay with regular hours at your base rate and extra hours at time and a half, double time or your own multiplier.
- [Time and a Half Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/time-and-a-half-calculator/): Time and a half calculator: enter your hourly rate to get your 1.5x overtime rate, pay for your overtime hours, and a chart of common wages.
- [EMI Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/emi-calculator/): Calculate the monthly EMI for any loan from the amount, interest rate and term, with total interest and a year-by-year amortization table.
- [Home Loan EMI Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/home-loan-emi-calculator/): Calculate your home loan EMI from the loan amount, interest rate and tenure, with total interest payable and a year-by-year breakdown.
- [Car Loan EMI Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/car-loan-emi-calculator/): Calculate your car or two-wheeler loan EMI from the loan amount, interest rate and tenure, with total interest payable and a repayment breakdown.
- [SIP Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/sip-calculator/): Project the future value of a monthly SIP (systematic investment plan) from the amount, expected return and duration, with a year-by-year growth table.
- [Loan Eligibility Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/loan-eligibility-calculator/): Estimate the loan amount your income can support from your monthly income, existing EMIs, interest rate and tenure, using the FOIR lenders typically apply.
- [GST Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/gst-calculator/): Add GST to a price or take it out of a GST-inclusive price at 5%, 18%, 40% or any rate, with the CGST and SGST split shown.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/compound-interest-calculator/): Calculate compound interest on a principal amount at any compounding frequency, with the maturity value and a year-by-year growth table.
- [Income Tax Calculator (India)](https://calc.streamerosai.com/income-tax-calculator-india/): Calculate India income tax for FY 2026-27 under the new or old regime, with the standard deduction, Section 87A rebate and 4% cess shown in the working.
- [Currency Converter](https://calc.streamerosai.com/currency-converter/): Convert between any two currencies at live exchange rates, including USD, EUR, GBP, INR, AUD, CAD and AED. Free, instant, no sign-up.
- [USD Salary to INR Calculator](https://calc.streamerosai.com/usd-salary-to-inr-calculator/): Convert a US dollar salary or hourly wage to Indian rupees: annual, monthly, weekly and hourly pay at live exchange rates.
- [USD to INR: US Dollar to Indian Rupee](https://calc.streamerosai.com/usd-to-inr/): Convert US dollars to Indian rupees at live exchange rates. Instant USD to INR (dollar to rupee) calculator with common amounts and rate details.
- [INR to USD: Indian Rupee to US Dollar](https://calc.streamerosai.com/inr-to-usd/): Convert Indian rupees to US dollars at live exchange rates. Instant INR to USD (rupee to dollar) calculator with common amounts, including lakh and crore.

## Guides

- [All guides](https://calc.streamerosai.com/guides/)
- [How to convert salary to hourly pay (the 2,080-hour rule)](https://calc.streamerosai.com/guides/salary-to-hourly/): How to turn an annual salary into an hourly wage and back, why 2,080 hours is the standard, and when to use a different number.
- [How overtime pay works in the US: time and a half explained](https://calc.streamerosai.com/guides/how-overtime-pay-works/): What the federal overtime rule requires, how time and a half is calculated, who is exempt, and why some states add daily overtime.
- [How exchange rates work: the mid-market rate vs the rate you get](https://calc.streamerosai.com/guides/how-exchange-rates-work/): What an exchange rate is, what the mid-market rate means, why banks and transfer apps give you less, and how to compare what you will actually receive.

## How it works

- Calculations run in your browser. Numbers you type are not uploaded.
- The formula is shown on each page. These are estimates for planning, not tax, legal or financial advice.
- Currency conversion uses public exchange-rate feeds fetched by your browser (currency-api via jsDelivr or Cloudflare Pages, then open.er-api.com as a fallback). The page shows the date the feed reports for its rates; rates are not live to the second.
- The percentage calculator lives on math.streamerosai.com, which is why it is not listed here. The minor currency pairs (EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, AED to INR) work but are kept out of the index; use the currency converter for them.
- The calculation functions are covered by unit tests (Vitest). No claim is made beyond what those tests check.
